spec.title: gitlab-sync
spec.description: Mirroring runs and GitLab API usage of gitlab-sync, from its OpenTelemetry metrics.

links.title: Fleet
links.tooltip: Every gitlab-sync tenant at a glance

spec.name: datasource
spec.label: Data source
spec.description: Prometheus receiving the gitlab-sync OTLP metrics.

spec.name: cluster
spec.label: Cluster
spec.description: k8s.cluster.name resource attribute (empty outside Kubernetes).

spec.name: namespace
spec.label: Namespace
spec.description: k8s.namespace.name resource attribute (empty outside Kubernetes).

spec.name: job
spec.label: Job
spec.description: service.name of the gitlab-sync deployment.

spec.name: version
spec.label: Version
spec.description: gitlab-sync version (service.version).

spec.name: role
spec.label: Instance
spec.description: Source or destination GitLab.

spec.name: entity
spec.label: Object
spec.description: Kind of GitLab object (Mirroring tab).

spec.name: status
spec.label: Status
spec.description: HTTP status code of the API calls, or error when no response was received.

spec.name: method
spec.label: Method
spec.description: HTTP method of the API calls.

spec.name: window
spec.label: Run window
spec.description: Smallest time bucket of the per-run panels. Set it to the schedule of gitlab-sync (or less): each process restarts its counters, so a bucket holding one run shows that run's totals.

spec.title: Last run
spec.description: Exit code of the most recent run in the time range.

spec.expr: last_over_time(max(gitlab_sync_run_status{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version"})[$__range:1m])

spec.title: Last run duration
spec.description: Duration of the most recent run.

spec.expr: max by (job) (last_over_time(gitlab_sync_run_duration_seconds{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version"}[$__interval]))

spec.title: Runs
spec.description: Runs that ended in the time range.

spec.expr: sum(count_over_time(gitlab_sync_run_status{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version"}[$__range]))

spec.title: Success rate
spec.description: Share of runs that exited with 0.

spec.expr: sum(count_over_time((gitlab_sync_run_status{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version"} == 0)[$__range:1m])) / sum(count_over_time(gitlab_sync_run_status{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version"}[$__range:1m]))

spec.title: API requests
spec.description: HTTP requests sent to both GitLab instances, retries included.

spec.expr: sum(increase(gitlab_sync_api_requests_total{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version", role=~"$role", method=~"$method", status=~"$status"}[$__range]))

spec.title: API error rate
spec.description: Share of requests answered 5xx or without a response.

spec.expr: sum(increase(gitlab_sync_api_requests_total{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version", role=~"$role", method=~"$method", status=~"$status", status_class=~"5xx|error"}[$__range])) / sum(increase(gitlab_sync_api_requests_total{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version", role=~"$role", method=~"$method", status=~"$status"}[$__range]))

spec.title: Retries
spec.description: Requests that retried a failed attempt.

spec.expr: sum(increase(gitlab_sync_api_retries_total{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version", role=~"$role"}[$__range]))

spec.title: API p95 latency
spec.description: 95th percentile of the API call durations over the time range.

spec.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (increase(gitlab_sync_api_duration_seconds_bucket{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version", role=~"$role", method=~"$method", status=~"$status"}[$__range])))

spec.title: Run status
spec.description: One block per run window, coloured by exit code.

spec.expr: max by (job) (last_over_time(gitlab_sync_run_status{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version"}[$__interval]))

spec.title: Run duration
spec.description: Duration of each run, by gitlab-sync version.

spec.expr: max by (service_version) (last_over_time(gitlab_sync_run_duration_seconds{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version"}[$__interval]))

spec.title: API requests per run
spec.description: Requests each run sent, by GitLab instance.

spec.expr: sum by (role) (max_over_time(gitlab_sync_api_requests_total{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version", role=~"$role", method=~"$method", status=~"$status"}[$__interval]))

spec.title: Instances
spec.description: Source and destination GitLab instances reported in the resource attributes.

spec.expr: max by (job, service_version, gitlab_sync_source_url, gitlab_sync_destination_url) (last_over_time(target_info{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version"}[$__range]))

spec.title: Projects mirrored
spec.description: Projects the last run created or synchronized successfully.

spec.expr: sum(sum by (job) (max_over_time(gitlab_sync_entities_total{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version", entity="project", outcome="success"}[$__interval]))) or on() (0 * count(last_over_time(gitlab_sync_run_status{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version"}[$__interval])))

spec.title: Projects failed
spec.description: Projects whose git, attributes, avatar or CI/CD catalog step failed in the last run.

spec.expr: sum(sum by (job) (max_over_time(gitlab_sync_entities_total{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version", entity="project", outcome="failure"}[$__interval]))) or on() (0 * count(last_over_time(gitlab_sync_run_status{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version"}[$__interval])))

spec.title: Blocking errors
spec.description: Blocking errors reported by the last run (any of them makes it exit with 1).

spec.expr: sum(sum by (job) (max_over_time(gitlab_sync_errors_total{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version", severity="blocking"}[$__interval]))) or on() (0 * count(last_over_time(gitlab_sync_run_status{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version"}[$__interval])))

spec.title: Non-blocking errors
spec.description: Non-blocking errors reported by the last run.

spec.expr: sum(sum by (job) (max_over_time(gitlab_sync_errors_total{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version", severity="non_blocking"}[$__interval]))) or on() (0 * count(last_over_time(gitlab_sync_run_status{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version"}[$__interval])))

spec.title: Run status
spec.description: Exit code of each run: OK (0), Failed (1, blocking errors), Warnings (2, non-blocking errors only).

spec.expr: max by (job, service_version) (last_over_time(gitlab_sync_run_status{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version"}[$__interval]))

spec.title: Runs by status
spec.description: How the runs of the time range ended.

spec.expr: round(sum(count_over_time(gitlab_sync_run_status{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version"}[$__range])) * sum(count_over_time((gitlab_sync_run_status{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version"} == 0)[$__range:1m])) / sum(count_over_time(gitlab_sync_run_status{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version"}[$__range:1m])))

round(sum(count_over_time(gitlab_sync_run_status{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version"}[$__range])) * sum(count_over_time((gitlab_sync_run_status{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version"} == 2)[$__range:1m])) / sum(count_over_time(gitlab_sync_run_status{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version"}[$__range:1m])))

round(sum(count_over_time(gitlab_sync_run_status{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version"}[$__range])) * sum(count_over_time((gitlab_sync_run_status{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version"} == 1)[$__range:1m])) / sum(count_over_time(gitlab_sync_run_status{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version"}[$__range:1m])))

spec.title: OK
spec.description: Runs that exited with 0.

spec.expr: round(sum(count_over_time(gitlab_sync_run_status{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version"}[$__range])) * sum(count_over_time((gitlab_sync_run_status{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version"} == 0)[$__range:1m])) / sum(count_over_time(gitlab_sync_run_status{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version"}[$__range:1m])))

spec.title: Warnings
spec.description: Runs with non-blocking errors only (exit code 2).

spec.expr: round(sum(count_over_time(gitlab_sync_run_status{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version"}[$__range])) * sum(count_over_time((gitlab_sync_run_status{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version"} == 2)[$__range:1m])) / sum(count_over_time(gitlab_sync_run_status{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version"}[$__range:1m])))

spec.title: Failed
spec.description: Runs with blocking errors (exit code 1).

spec.expr: round(sum(count_over_time(gitlab_sync_run_status{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version"}[$__range])) * sum(count_over_time((gitlab_sync_run_status{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version"} == 1)[$__range:1m])) / sum(count_over_time(gitlab_sync_run_status{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version"}[$__range:1m])))

spec.title: Unsuccessful runs per day
spec.description: Runs that did not exit with 0, per day.

spec.expr: round(sum(count_over_time(gitlab_sync_run_status{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version"}[1d])) * sum(count_over_time((gitlab_sync_run_status{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version"} == 2)[1d:1m])) / sum(count_over_time(gitlab_sync_run_status{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version"}[1d:1m])))

round(sum(count_over_time(gitlab_sync_run_status{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version"}[1d])) * sum(count_over_time((gitlab_sync_run_status{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version"} == 1)[1d:1m])) / sum(count_over_time(gitlab_sync_run_status{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version"}[1d:1m])))

spec.title: Duration per run
spec.description: Duration of each run, by gitlab-sync version.

spec.expr: max by (service_version) (last_over_time(gitlab_sync_run_duration_seconds{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version"}[$__interval]))
min(min_over_time(gitlab_sync_run_duration_seconds{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version"}[$__range]))

sum(sum_over_time(gitlab_sync_run_duration_seconds{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version"}[$__range])) / sum(count_over_time(gitlab_sync_run_duration_seconds{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version"}[$__range]))
max(quantile_over_time(0.95, gitlab_sync_run_duration_seconds{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version"}[$__range]))
max(max_over_time(gitlab_sync_run_duration_seconds{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version"}[$__range]))

spec.title: Run duration distribution
spec.description: How run durations spread, by version.

spec.expr: last_over_time(gitlab_sync_run_duration_seconds{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version"}[$__interval])

spec.title: Runs by version
spec.description: One line per gitlab-sync version seen in the time range.

spec.expr: sum by (service_version) (count_over_time(gitlab_sync_run_status{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version"}[$__range]))

sum by (service_version) (count_over_time((gitlab_sync_run_status{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version"} == 0)[$__range:1m])) / sum by (service_version) (count_over_time(gitlab_sync_run_status{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version"}[$__range:1m]))

sum by (service_version) (sum_over_time(gitlab_sync_run_duration_seconds{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version"}[$__range])) / sum by (service_version) (count_over_time(gitlab_sync_run_duration_seconds{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version"}[$__range]))
max by (service_version) (max_over_time(gitlab_sync_run_duration_seconds{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version"}[$__range]))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (service_version, le) (increase(gitlab_sync_api_duration_seconds_bucket{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version", role=~"$role", method=~"$method", status=~"$status"}[$__range])))

sum by (service_version) (sum_over_time(gitlab_sync_run_duration_seconds{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version"}[$__range])) / sum by (service_version) (count_over_time(gitlab_sync_run_duration_seconds{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version"}[$__range]))

spec.title: Requests per run by instance
spec.description: Requests each run sent to the source and the destination GitLab.

spec.expr: sum by (role) (max_over_time(gitlab_sync_api_requests_total{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version", role=~"$role", method=~"$method", status=~"$status"}[$__interval]))

sum by (method) (max_over_time(gitlab_sync_api_requests_total{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version", role=~"$role", method=~"$method", status=~"$status"}[$__interval]))

spec.title: Requests per run by status class
spec.description: error means no HTTP response was received (timeout, connection reset...).

spec.expr: sum by (status_class) (max_over_time(gitlab_sync_api_requests_total{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version", role=~"$role", method=~"$method", status=~"$status"}[$__interval]))

sum(increase(gitlab_sync_api_requests_total{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version", role=~"$role", method=~"$method", status=~"$status", role="source"}[$__range]))

sum(increase(gitlab_sync_api_requests_total{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version", role=~"$role", method=~"$method", status=~"$status", role="destination"}[$__range]))

sum(increase(gitlab_sync_api_requests_total{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version", role=~"$role", method=~"$method", status=~"$status"}[$__range])) / sum(count_over_time(gitlab_sync_run_status{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version"}[$__range]))

sum by (role, method) (increase(gitlab_sync_api_requests_total{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version", role=~"$role", method=~"$method", status=~"$status"}[$__range]))

spec.title: Request throughput
spec.description: API requests per second of run time.

spec.expr: sum(increase(gitlab_sync_api_requests_total{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version", role=~"$role", method=~"$method", status=~"$status"}[$__range])) / sum(sum_over_time(gitlab_sync_run_duration_seconds{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version"}[$__range]))

spec.title: Requests by status code
spec.description: Over the time range. error means no HTTP response was received.

spec.expr: sort_desc(sum by (status) (increase(gitlab_sync_api_requests_total{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version", role=~"$role", method=~"$method", status=~"$status"}[$__range])))

spec.title: Latency percentiles per run
spec.description: Percentiles of the API call durations of each run.

spec.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le) (max_over_time(gitlab_sync_api_duration_seconds_bucket{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version", role=~"$role", method=~"$method", status=~"$status"}[$__interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (max_over_time(gitlab_sync_api_duration_seconds_bucket{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version", role=~"$role", method=~"$method", status=~"$status"}[$__interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (max_over_time(gitlab_sync_api_duration_seconds_bucket{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version", role=~"$role", method=~"$method", status=~"$status"}[$__interval])))

spec.title: p95 latency per run by instance

spec.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, role) (max_over_time(gitlab_sync_api_duration_seconds_bucket{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version", role=~"$role", method=~"$method", status=~"$status"}[$__interval])))

spec.title: p95 latency per run by method

spec.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, role, method) (max_over_time(gitlab_sync_api_duration_seconds_bucket{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version", role=~"$role", method=~"$method", status=~"$status"}[$__interval])))

spec.title: Mean latency per run by instance

spec.expr: sum by (role) (max_over_time(gitlab_sync_api_duration_seconds_sum{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version", role=~"$role", method=~"$method", status=~"$status"}[$__interval])) / sum by (role) (max_over_time(gitlab_sync_api_duration_seconds_count{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version", role=~"$role", method=~"$method", status=~"$status"}[$__interval]))

spec.title: Latency heatmap
spec.description: Distribution of the API call durations, per run window.

spec.expr: sum by (le) (max_over_time(gitlab_sync_api_duration_seconds_bucket{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version", role=~"$role", method=~"$method", status=~"$status"}[$__interval]))

spec.title: Error ratio per run by instance
spec.description: Share of each run's requests answered 5xx or without a response.

spec.expr: (sum by (role) (max_over_time(gitlab_sync_api_requests_total{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version", role=~"$role", method=~"$method", status=~"$status", status_class=~"5xx|error"}[$__interval])) or 0 * sum by (role) (max_over_time(gitlab_sync_api_requests_total{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version", role=~"$role", method=~"$method", status=~"$status"}[$__interval]))) / sum by (role) (max_over_time(gitlab_sync_api_requests_total{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version", role=~"$role", method=~"$method", status=~"$status"}[$__interval]))

spec.title: Failed requests per run
spec.description: 4xx are often expected (a 404 while looking a project up); 5xx and error are retried.

spec.expr: sum by (status) (max_over_time(gitlab_sync_api_requests_total{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version", role=~"$role", method=~"$method", status=~"$status", status_class!="2xx"}[$__interval]))

spec.title: Failed requests
spec.description: Non-2xx requests over the time range.

spec.expr: sum by (role, method, status) (increase(gitlab_sync_api_requests_total{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version", role=~"$role", method=~"$method", status=~"$status", status_class!="2xx"}[$__range]))

spec.title: Retries per run by instance
spec.description: Requests that were a retry of a failed attempt (5xx, 429, connection errors).

spec.expr: sum by (role) (max_over_time(gitlab_sync_api_retries_total{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version", role=~"$role"}[$__interval]))

spec.title: Retry ratio per run
spec.description: Retries over all requests: the extra load caused by failures.

spec.expr: sum by (role) (max_over_time(gitlab_sync_api_retries_total{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version", role=~"$role"}[$__interval])) / sum by (role) (max_over_time(gitlab_sync_api_requests_total{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version", role=~"$role"}[$__interval]))
sum(increase(gitlab_sync_api_retries_total{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version", role=~"$role", role="source"}[$__range]))
sum(increase(gitlab_sync_api_retries_total{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version", role=~"$role", role="destination"}[$__range]))

spec.title: Rate-limited requests
spec.description: Requests answered 429 Too Many Requests over the time range: GitLab's rate limits, retried after a pause.

spec.expr: sum(increase(gitlab_sync_api_requests_total{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version", role=~"$role", status="429"}[$__range])) or vector(0)

spec.title: Rate-limited requests (429) per run
spec.description: GitLab rate limits hit by each run. They are retried, so they add to the retries and slow the run down.

spec.expr: sum by (role) (max_over_time(gitlab_sync_api_requests_total{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version", role=~"$role", status="429"}[$__interval]))

spec.title: Groups
spec.description: Groups processed by the last run, whatever the operation.

spec.expr: sum(sum by (job) (max_over_time(gitlab_sync_entities_total{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version", entity="group"}[$__interval]))) or on() (0 * count(last_over_time(gitlab_sync_run_status{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version"}[$__interval])))

spec.title: Projects
spec.description: Projects processed by the last run, whatever the operation.

spec.expr: sum(sum by (job) (max_over_time(gitlab_sync_entities_total{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version", entity="project"}[$__interval]))) or on() (0 * count(last_over_time(gitlab_sync_run_status{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version"}[$__interval])))

spec.title: Releases
spec.description: Releases processed by the last run, whatever the operation.

spec.expr: sum(sum by (job) (max_over_time(gitlab_sync_entities_total{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version", entity="release"}[$__interval]))) or on() (0 * count(last_over_time(gitlab_sync_run_status{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version"}[$__interval])))

spec.title: Assets
spec.description: Assets processed by the last run, whatever the operation.

spec.expr: sum(sum by (job) (max_over_time(gitlab_sync_entities_total{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version", entity="asset"}[$__interval]))) or on() (0 * count(last_over_time(gitlab_sync_run_status{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version"}[$__interval])))

spec.title: Issues
spec.description: Issues processed by the last run, whatever the operation.

spec.expr: sum(sum by (job) (max_over_time(gitlab_sync_entities_total{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version", entity="issue"}[$__interval]))) or on() (0 * count(last_over_time(gitlab_sync_run_status{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version"}[$__interval])))

spec.title: Changes
spec.description: Objects the last run created or deleted on the destination.

spec.expr: sum(sum by (job) (max_over_time(gitlab_sync_entities_total{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version", entity=~"$entity", operation=~"create|delete"}[$__interval]))) or on() (0 * count(last_over_time(gitlab_sync_run_status{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version"}[$__interval])))

spec.title: Objects per run by kind
spec.description: Every object each run went through, skipped ones included.

spec.expr: sum by (entity) (max_over_time(gitlab_sync_entities_total{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version", entity=~"$entity"}[$__interval]))

spec.title: Objects per run by operation
spec.description: create and delete change the destination; sync re-mirrors an existing object; skip leaves it as it is.

spec.expr: sum by (operation) (max_over_time(gitlab_sync_entities_total{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version", entity=~"$entity"}[$__interval]))

spec.title: Created and deleted per run
spec.description: What actually changed on the destination.

spec.expr: sum by (entity, operation) (max_over_time(gitlab_sync_entities_total{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version", entity=~"$entity", operation=~"create|delete"}[$__interval]))

spec.title: Objects over the time range
spec.description: Totals of the time range (increase(), so the first run of the range is partly missed).

spec.expr: sum by (entity, operation, outcome) (increase(gitlab_sync_entities_total{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version", entity=~"$entity"}[$__range]))

spec.title: Failed objects per run
spec.description: Objects whose operation failed. A project fails when its git, attributes, avatar or CI/CD catalog step failed.

spec.expr: sum by (entity) (max_over_time(gitlab_sync_entities_total{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version", entity=~"$entity", outcome="failure"}[$__interval]))

spec.title: Errors per run
spec.description: Errors reported during each run. Any blocking error makes the run exit with 1.

spec.expr: sum by (severity) (max_over_time(gitlab_sync_errors_total{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version"}[$__interval]))

spec.title: Failure ratio per run by kind
spec.description: Share of each kind of object whose operation failed.

spec.expr: (sum by (entity) (max_over_time(gitlab_sync_entities_total{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version", entity=~"$entity", outcome="failure"}[$__interval])) or 0 * sum by (entity) (max_over_time(gitlab_sync_entities_total{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version", entity=~"$entity"}[$__interval]))) / sum by (entity) (max_over_time(gitlab_sync_entities_total{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version", entity=~"$entity"}[$__interval]))

spec.title: Blocking errors
spec.description: Over the time range.

spec.expr: sum(increase(gitlab_sync_errors_total{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version", severity="blocking"}[$__range]))

spec.title: Non-blocking errors
spec.description: Over the time range.

spec.expr: sum(increase(gitlab_sync_errors_total{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version", severity="non_blocking"}[$__range]))

spec.title: Failed objects
spec.description: Over the time range.

spec.expr: sum(increase(gitlab_sync_entities_total{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version", entity=~"$entity", outcome="failure"}[$__range]))

spec.title: Runs with errors
spec.description: Runs that did not exit with 0.

spec.expr: round(sum(count_over_time(gitlab_sync_run_status{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version"}[$__range])) * sum(count_over_time((gitlab_sync_run_status{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version"} > 0)[$__range:1m])) / sum(count_over_time(gitlab_sync_run_status{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version"}[$__range:1m])))

spec.title: Phase durations per run
spec.description: The phases run one after the other, so the stack is the run duration (minus the setup).

spec.expr: max by (phase) (last_over_time(gitlab_sync_phase_duration_seconds{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version"}[$__interval]))
avg by (phase) (avg_over_time(gitlab_sync_phase_duration_seconds{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version"}[$__range]))
max by (phase) (max_over_time(gitlab_sync_phase_duration_seconds{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version"}[$__range]))

spec.title: Share of the run time
spec.description: Average time of each phase, as a share of the run.

spec.expr: sum by (phase) (sum_over_time(gitlab_sync_phase_duration_seconds{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version"}[$__range]) / count_over_time(gitlab_sync_phase_duration_seconds{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version"}[$__range]))

spec.title: Pushes per run
spec.description: Freemium mirroring only: one push per project. An already up-to-date push is a success.

spec.expr: sum by (outcome) (max_over_time(gitlab_sync_git_push_duration_seconds_count{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version"}[$__interval]))

spec.title: Push duration percentiles per run
spec.description: Only the push itself, not the clone or fetch.

spec.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le) (max_over_time(gitlab_sync_git_push_duration_seconds_bucket{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version"}[$__interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (max_over_time(gitlab_sync_git_push_duration_seconds_bucket{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version"}[$__interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (max_over_time(gitlab_sync_git_push_duration_seconds_bucket{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version"}[$__interval])))

spec.title: Push time per run
spec.description: Time spent pushing, summed over the run's pushes.

spec.expr: sum by (outcome) (max_over_time(gitlab_sync_git_push_duration_seconds_sum{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version"}[$__interval]))

spec.title: Push duration heatmap
spec.description: Distribution of the push durations, per run window.

spec.expr: sum by (le) (max_over_time(gitlab_sync_git_push_duration_seconds_bucket{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version"}[$__interval]))

spec.title: Pushes
spec.description: Over the time range.

spec.expr: sum(increase(gitlab_sync_git_push_duration_seconds_count{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version"}[$__range]))

spec.title: Failed pushes
spec.description: Over the time range.

spec.expr: sum(increase(gitlab_sync_git_push_duration_seconds_count{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version", outcome="failure"}[$__range])) or vector(0)

spec.title: Push p95
spec.description: Over the time range.

spec.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (increase(gitlab_sync_git_push_duration_seconds_bucket{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version"}[$__range])))

spec.title: Push mean
spec.description: Over the time range.

spec.expr: sum(increase(gitlab_sync_git_push_duration_seconds_sum{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version"}[$__range])) / sum(increase(gitlab_sync_git_push_duration_seconds_count{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version"}[$__range]))

spec.title: Cache lookups per run
spec.description: --cache-dir only. hit: cached repository refreshed with a fetch; miss: cloned; invalid: unusable, cloned again.

spec.expr: sum by (result) (max_over_time(gitlab_sync_git_cache_total{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version"}[$__interval]))

(sum by (job) (max_over_time(gitlab_sync_git_cache_total{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version", result="hit"}[$__interval]))) / (sum by (job) (max_over_time(gitlab_sync_git_cache_total{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version"}[$__interval])))

spec.title: Hit ratio
spec.description: Over the time range.

spec.expr: sum(increase(gitlab_sync_git_cache_total{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version", result="hit"}[$__range])) / sum(increase(gitlab_sync_git_cache_total{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version"}[$__range]))

spec.title: Lookups by result
spec.description: Over the time range.

spec.expr: sum by (result) (increase(gitlab_sync_git_cache_total{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version"}[$__range]))

spec.title: Invalid entries
spec.description: Cached repositories that were unusable and had to be cloned again.

spec.expr: sum(increase(gitlab_sync_git_cache_total{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", service_version=~"$version", result="invalid"}[$__range])) or vector(0)
